m: उप-शाखा f. a smaller branch of a tree, little branch, BhP. iv, 31, 14; Sāy.
a: उपशाखा — A secondary branch.
उपशांत — p. p. 1 Calmed, appeased, pacified. --2 Calm, tranquil. --3 Lessened, diminished.
उपशांतिः — f. 1 Cessation, allaying, quieting, alleviation; आर्तभयोपशांतये R. 8. 31; Amaru. 65. --2 Appeasing, assuaging, pacification, satisfaction (of desires); Pt. 1. 147.
उपशांतिन् — a. 1 Appeased, pacified. --2 Calm, tranquil. --m. A tame elephant.
उपशांत्वनं — Appeasing(see उपसांत्वन).

m: उप-शाक अस्, m. a helper, companion, RV. i, 33, 4.
उप-शाल n. a place or court in front of a house, Kauś.
a: उपशालं — A place near a house, a court before a house. --लं ind. Near a house.

m: उप-शालम् ind. (fr. शाला, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 121) near a house.
उप-शामक mfn. calming, quieting, affording repose, making patient, Lalit.
उपशान्तात्मन् mfn. one whose mind is pacified, placid, BhP.
उप-शान्त mfn. calmed, appeased, pacified
calm, tranquil, BhP.; Kathās.
ceased, extinct, intermitted, R.; PraśnUp.
n. tranquillity, peace, Sukh. i.
उप-शान्त—वैर mfn. one whose enmity has ceased, reconciled, pacified, VarBṛS.

m: उप-शान्ति f. cessation, intermission, remission, Suśr.; Ragh.; Hit. &c.
tranquillity, calmness.

tame

उप-√ शान्त्व् See उप-√ सान्त्व्.
उप-शास्त्र n. a minor science or treatise, L.
a: उपशास्त्रं — A minor science or treatise.

a: उपशायः — Sleeping in turn, rotation for sleeping with (another who keeps watch at night).

k.v: उपशायो विशायश्च पर्यायशयनार्थकौ। अर्तनं च ऋतीया च हृणीया च घृणार्थकाः॥

m: उपशायक mf(इका)n. sleeping alternately with, Bhaṭṭ.
उपशायक m. N. of a man, VārP.

m: उप-शायिन् mfn. lying near to or by the side of KātyŚr.
lying, sleeping, R.
lying down, going to bed, MBh.
allaying, tranquillizing, anything that calms &c.
(in med.) composing, narcotic, W.
a: उपशायिन् — a. 1 Lying near to. --2 Sleeping, going to bed. --3 Allaying, calming. --4 Composing or narcotic (in medicine); ˚ता, -त्वं tranquilling; calming, secondary means of cure (as diet &c.).

m: उपशायि-ता, f. or उपशायि-त्व, n. tranquillization, calming means of allaying disease (as diet &c.), W.
उप-शैल m. a hill, Hcat.

उप-√ शी Ā. -शेते, to lie near or by the side of (acc.), RV. x, 18, 8; ŚBr.; Kauś.; MBh.; to lie by the side of (for sexual intercourse), ŚBr.; TS.; Kāṭh.; MBh. xiii; to lie upon (loc.), R. vi; to do good, be suitable or useful, Car.
a: उपशी — {c2c} A. 1 To lie near. --2 To cohabit. --3 To do good to, agree with; यन्ममोपशेते Caraka.

m: उप-शीर्षक n. a kind of disease of the head, ŚārṅgS.
उप-शीवन् mf(˚वरी)n. lying near or by the side of MaitrS. ii, 13, 16; Kāṭh.
उप-√ शङ्क् Ā. to suspect, suppose, think, MBh.; R.
उप-शफ m. a hind hoof, Sāy. on TBr. ii, 6, 4.
उप-शद m. (perhaps fr. √ 2. शद्, ‘to excel’) a particular Ekāha or sacrifice during one day, ĀśvŚr.; Vait.
removal of an impediment to get children, Sāy. on TāṇḍyaBr. xix, 3, 1.

उप-√ शक् P. (pf. 1. pl. -शेकिम) to be able to bring into one's power, master, be superior, AV. vi, 114, 2; 3 [= TBr. ii, 4, 4, 9] : Desid. P. -शिक्षति, to endeavour to bring into one's power, master or subdue; to bring or draw near, call near, allure; to bring into one's possession, RV.; AV. vii, 12, 1; xi, 8, 17; TBr.; TāṇḍyaBr. : Ā. -शिक्षते, to try, undertake, ŚāṅkhBr.; to endeavour to help or serve, offer one's service, MBh.; to learn, inquire into, MBh.; BhP. : Caus. of Desid. P. -शिक्षयति, to teach, train, BhP.

s: klI, (upagataM Salyam .) grAmaprAntaBAgaH । tatparyyAyaH । grAmAntam 2 । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA raGO 15 । 60 । “upaSalyanivizwEstEScaturddAramuKI baBO” ॥ “BramaMSca viSAlopaSalye kamapyAkrIqamAsAdya” । iti daSakumAre ॥)
v: upaSalya

na॰ upagataM Salyam asTisTAnaM (BAgAqa) atyA॰ sa॰ । grAmAnte “mramaMSca viSAlopaSalye kamapyAkrIqamAsAdya” daSakumA॰ । “upaSalyanivizwEstEH” “aTopaSalye ripumagnaSalyaH” raGuH । upacArAt 2 prAntaBAge ca । “SElopaSalyanipatadrayanemiDArA” iti mAGaH ।
m: उप-शल्य m. a small spear or lance tipped with iron, MBh. iii, 641
उप-शल्य n. a neighbouring district, environs, the ground near a village, Daś.; Ragh.
the ground at the base or edge of a mountain, Śiś. v, 8.
a: उपशल्यं — An open place in the vicinity of a town or village, suburb; अथोपशल्ये रिपुमग्नशल्यः R. 16. 37, 15. 60; Śi. 5. 8, K. 50.

k.v: ग्रामान्तमुपशल्यं स्यात्सीमसीमे स्त्रियामुभे। घोष आभीरपल्ली स्यात्पक्कणः शबरालयः॥

m: उप-शल्यक n. a small piece of ground near a village, Kād.

उप-√ शम् P. Ā. -शाम्यति, -ते, to become calm or quiet; to cease, become extinct, AitBr.; Kauś.; ĀśvGṛ.; ChUp.; MBh. &c.: Caus. -शमयति and ep. -शामयति, to make quiet, calm, extinguish; to tranquillize, appease, pacify, mitigate, MBh.; VarBṛS.; Daś. &c.
a: उपशम् — {c4c} P. 1 To become calm or quiet, be assuaged; उपशाम्यतु ते बुद्धिः Bk. 20. 5. --2 To cease, stop; अग्निः, शब्दः, कोपः &c.; cease to speak; K. 110. --Caus. 1 To calm, tranquillize. --2 To appease, pacify, assuage, mitigate. --3 To extinguish, kill.

m: उपशमायन mfn. going to or obtaining tranquillity of mind, BhP. v, 1, 29.

s: puM, (upa + Sam + GaY .) SamatA । tatparyyAyaH । SamaH 2 SAntiH 3 SamaTaH 4 tfzRAkzayaH 5 । iti hemacandraH ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate 1 । pOzyopAsyAne । 3 । 120 । “na hi me manyuradyApi upaSamaM gacCati” । taTA praboDacandrodaye । 5 । 15 । “taTAyamapi kftakarttavyaH saMprati paramAmupaSamanizWAM prAptaH” ॥)
v: upaSama

pu॰ upa + Sama--GaY avfdDiH । 1 indriyARAM nigrahe 2 tfzRAnASe, 3 rogopadravaSAntO ca । “tezAM pEttikAnAM vyADInAmupaSamohemante, SlEzmikARAM, nidAGe vAtikAnAM GanAtyaye svaBAvata eva ta ete saYcayaprakopopa SamAH” “tatkAlameva kzatozmaRaH prasftasyopaSamArTam” iti ca suSru॰ । 4 nivfttO “jagatyupaSamaM yAte nazwayajYotsavAkule” BA॰ va॰ 20 a॰ ।
m: उप-शम m. the becoming quiet, assuagement, alleviation, stopping, cessation, relaxation, intermission, MāṇḍUp.; Prab.; Pañcat. &c.
tranquillity of mind, calmness, patience, MBh. iii; Bhartṛ.; Śāntiś.
(in astron.) N. of the twentieth Muhūrta.
a: उपशमः — 1 Becoming quiet, assuagement, pacification; कुतोऽस्या उपशमः Ve. 3; मन्युर्दुःसह एष यात्युपशमं नो सांत्ववादैः स्फुटं Amaru. 5; cessation, stopping, extinction. --2 Relaxation, intermission. --3 Tranquility, calmness, patience; ज्ञानस्योपशमः Bh. 2. 82. --4 Control or restraint of the senses.
उपशमक — a. Appeasing, pacifying, affording repose, making patient.

m: उप-शम—क्षय m. (with Jainas) the destruction (of activity &c.) through quietism, Sarvad.
उप-शमनीय mfn. to be appeased or made quiet, Sāh.
(उपशमनीय fr. उप-शमन), serving as an anodyne, calming, appeasing, Car.

v: upaSamana

na॰ upa + Sama--BAve lyuw । upaSamArTe “vyADInA murpaSamanArTam” suSru॰ । upa + Sama--Ric--lyuw । avfdDiH 2 nivAraRe । tasmE hitam Ca । upaSaSanIya rogaSAntihetO Ayurvede । karmmaRi anIyar । nivAraRIye । “kawukOzaDiSamanoyasya” sA॰ da॰ ।
m: उप-शमन mf(ई)n. calming, appeasing, BhP.
उप-शमन n. the becoming extinct, ceasing, Nir.
calming, appeasing, mitigation, MBh.; BhP.; Suśr.; Pañcat.
an anodyne.
a: उपशमनं — 1 Quieting, calming, appeasing. --2 Mitigation, assuagement. --3 Extinction, cessation.

m: उप-शम—वत् and उप-शम—शील, mfn. placid, calm, tranquil.

m: उप-शय See उप-√ शी.
उप-शय mfn. lying near at hand or close by, lying ready for use, ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.

the lying near or by the side of
a kind of hole in the ground (placed near the track of wild animals, for a hunter to conceal himself in Mall. on Śiś. ii, 80)
(in med.) the allaying (of diseases) by suitable remedies, suitableness, usefulness, advantageous medicine, Car.
the liking, predilection (of a sick person as for coolness &c.), ib.
diagnosis by the effect of certain articles of food or medicine, W.
a: उपशय — See under उपशी.

m: उप-शय—स्थ mfn. lying in ambush (as a hunter), Śiś. ii, 80.
उप-शय—त्व n. the being a particular sacrificial post, TS. vi, 6, 6, 4.

m: उप-√ शिङ्घ् P. -शिङ्घति, to smell at, kiss, Bhaṭṭ.
उप-शिङ्घन n. (in med.) anything given to smell at, Suśr. ii, 515, 11
(-शिंहन, -सिंहन are wrong readings.)

learning, acquisition, Mṛcch.; Kathās.

a: उपशिक्षा --क्षणं — Learning, training.

m: उप-शिक्षण n. taking into discipleship or apprenticeship, ĀpŚr., Sch.
उप-शिक्षित mfn. learnt, studied
trained, MBh.; BhP.
उप-शिरस् ind. upon the head, Kauś. 86.
उप-शिव m. N. of a man.

m: उप-शिष्य m. the pupil of a pupil, Prab.
a: उपशिष्यः — The pupil of a pupil; शिष्योपशिष्यैरुपगीयमानमवेहि तन्मंडनमिश्रधाम Udb.

m: उप-श्लाघा f. boasting, brag, swagger, GopBr.

embrace, Prab.
a: उपश्लेषः, --षणं — 1 Juxta-position, contact. --2 An embrace.

m: उप-श्लेषण n. the act of joining or fixing on, sewing together, Sarvad.
उप-√ श्लिष् P. -श्लिष्यति, to come near to or into close contact with, cling to, MBh.; Daś. : Caus. -श्लेषयति, to bring near or into close contact, Vikr.
a: उपश्लिष् — {c4c} P. 1 To embrace. --2 To draw near, approach. --Caus. To bring near, place at hand; उपश्लेषय रथं V. 1; शरं V. 5.

m: उप-श्लिष्ट mfn. brought near or into close contact, contiguous, adjoining, TBr. iii, 8, 17, 4; Pañcat.
a: उपश्लिष्ट — p. p. Placed near, contiguous, adjoining.

m: उप-श्लोक m. N. of the father of the tenth Manu, BhP. viii, 13, 21.
उप-श्लोकय Nom. (fr. श्लोक, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 25) P. -श्लोकयति, to praise in Ślokas.

a: उपश्लोकयति — Den. P. To extolor praise in verses; समुत्तेजनसमर्थैः श्लोकैरुपश्लोकयितव्यः Mu. 4.

SlokErupastOti upa + Sloka + Ric nAmaDAtuH uBa॰ saka॰ sew । upaSlokayati--te upASuSlokat--ta upaSlokayAm--baBUva--Asa--cakAra cakre upaSlokayan upaSlokitaH upaSlokayitum upaSlokanam ।

2. उप-शोभा (for 1. See col. 1) f. secondary ornament or decoration, AgP.; Hcat.

v: upaSoBa
strI upagatA SoBAM sAdfSyena atyA॰ sa॰ । AropitaSoBAyAm “vihitopaSoBamupayAti mADave” mAGaH ।

m: उप-शोभन n. the act of adorning, ornamenting, R.; BhP.
a: उपशोभनं, --शोभा — Adorning, ornamenting.

m: उप-शोभिका f. ornament, decoration, AgP.
उपशोभिन् mfn. of beautiful appearance, brilliant, Kathās.
उप-शोभित mfn. adorned, ornamented, decorated, MBh.; MārkP.; Suśr.; Pañcat. &c.
उप-शोष mfn. drying up, withering, R. (B.).

v: upaSozaRa

na॰ upa + Suza--Ric--lyuw । 1 SozaRasADane vyApAre । upaSozayati karttari lyu । 2 tatkArake tri॰ (kawukaH) “viRma trakledamedovasApayopaSozaRaSceti” (kazAyaH) “kledopaSozaRaSceti suSru॰ । SozaRaYcAntaHsTitajalAdervAtozmAdinA nAsanam ।
m: उप-शोषण mfn. the act of causing to dry up or shrink, Suśr.; Prab.
a: उपशोषणं — Drying up, withering.

m: उप-शोषित mfn. made dry, dried, dry, MBh.; Suśr.
उप-श्री f. an over-garment (fitting closely), KauṣUp.
a: उपश्री — f. Covering, anything thrown above or upon.

m: उप-√ श्रम् P. -श्राम्यति, to rest, repose, Kauś.

उप-√ श्रि P. -श्रयति, to lean (anything) against, TBr. i, 6, 6, 2; ŚBr. xiv; KātyŚr.: Ā. -श्रयते (p. of the pf. -शिश्रियाण) to lean against, support, prop, RV. x, 18, 12; to cling to, fit closely (as an ornament), RV. vii, 56, 13; to place one's self near to, go towards, MBh.; BhP.; to accommodate one's self to, ChUp. vi, 8, 2.
उप-श्रित mfn. placed near, brought to the attention of RV. vii, 86, 8
leaning towards or upon, TS.; VS.; KātyŚr.
उप-श्रोतृ ता, m. a listener, hearer, RV. vii, 23, 1; TS.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; Vait.
a: उपश्रोतृ — a. Listening, hearing.

m: उप-√ श्रु P. -शृणोति, to listen to, give ear to, hear, RV.; AV. xii, 4, 27; xx, 27, 1; ŚBr.; TāṇḍyaBr.; TBr.; ChUp.; MBh. &c.
a: उपश्रु — {c5c} P. 1 To hear, listen; वचः, गिरः &c. --2 To promise.

v: upaSrut
pu॰ SrUyate Sru + sampa॰ kvip Srut stutiH upagatA Srud yasmin । yajYe “A nA yAtamupaSrutyaSvinA f॰ 8, 9, 5, “upaSruti yajYe” BA॰
a: उपश्रुत् — m. A sacrifice.

s: tri, (upa + Sru + kta .) pratiSrutam । aNgIkftam । ityamaraH ॥
m: उप-श्रुत mfn. listened to, heard, MBh.; Hariv.; BhP.

mahAdevasya vallaBe! । vimohaya janAn sarvAn mamAtra vaSagAn karu । vastreRa badvanetraH sannIyate'nyena tadgfham । gfhopari parikzipya muktanetraH SrutirBavet” । “tadgfhe matuzyaSabdAn yadi SfRuyAt । tacCuBamaSuBaM vA vicAryAdezwavyam । tezu Sabdezu kasarAnvarjayitvAnyaSabdAdivarRAH SrezWAH । prayAhi gfhARa gacCa Bavati aTArjanArTA dAnArTA lABArTAH sADuSabdAH praSastAH tezvapi kAkvarTA duzwAH na yAhi na gacCa nAsti BavatyarTA ayAnaSabdASca gamane duzwAH tacCabdAn SfRvan yAtrAM nivarttayet । atyutkawakArye tu dvirAcamya kaladevatAM saMsmftya muhUrttaM tizWan gacCet । vEnyaM pfTuM hEhayamityAdi paWan punarapi nizidDaprayARaScet kzutAdiBistadA sidDivinAyakavratopayAcitaM maMkalpya gacCet । tatrApi nizidDaScenna gacCedeva” vi॰ pA॰ ।
m: उप-श्रुति f. giving ear to, listening attentively, RV. i, 10, 3; viii, 8, 5; 34, 11; AV. ii, 16, 2; xvi, 2, 5
range of hearing, ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
hearing, BhP.
rumour, report, MBh. v, 30, 5 (ed. Bomb.; अप-श्रुति, ed. Calc. v, 871)
a kind of supernatural oracular voice (answering questions about future events, and supposed to be uttered by an idol after mystic invocations, Vidhāna-pārijāta, T.), MBh.; Kād. &c., (cf. शकुनोप˚)
उप-श्रुति m. N. of an evil spirit, PārGṛ. i, 16, 23.
a: उपश्रुतिः — f. 1 Hearing, listening. --2 Range of hearing. --3 A supernatural voice heard at night, and personified as a nocturnal deity revealing the future; नक्तं निर्गत्य यत्किंचिच्छुभाशुभकरं वचः . श्रूयते तद्विदुर्धीरा देवप्रश्नमुपश्रुतिं .. Hārāvalī; परिजनोऽपि चास्याः सततमुपश्रुत्यै निर्जगाम K. 65. --4 Aspect of the stars, fortune-telling. --5 Promise, assent.

a: उपशुभ् — Caus. P. To adorn, ornament, decorate.
